notes:
Account snapshot: Cinnabar RC is a mid-tier investment firm building a consolidated search layer across research, legal, and compliance datasets. Primary ask: massive-scale open-index + cross-encoder rerank for top-k precision.

Key numbers / constraints:
- Current index target: 200M vectors initial, planning 600M within 12 months, growth path to 1B+ vectors by year 2.
- Ingest target: 0.8-1.2M vectors/day during bulk reindex windows; steady-state daily insert ~100k.
- Serving: expected peak QPS ~2k-3k depending on market open; tail sensitivity during earnings windows.
- Latency targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms for 10–20 doc retrieval + cross-encoder rerank.
- Unit cost goal: <$0.001 per query end-to-end (embedding + retrieval + rerank) — very aggressive.

Technical preferences and ask:
- Prefer open embeddings to avoid licensing; evaluated open-embed-large-v2 family.
- Rerank: cross-encoder style runner for top-50 => top-5; experimenting with distilled cross-encoders to trade cost/latency.
- Want batching + prefix/KV caching to reduce token cost on rerank and to amortize embedding compute.
- Strong interest in quantized model variants for rerank (4-bit) with fallback to full fp16 when latency allows.
- Network: must run in customer VPC for data residency (US-East), with optional on-prem airgap for select subsets of legal data.
- KMS/HSM integration for keys; must produce audit logs for every inference.

POC summary / timeline (shorthand):
- 2025-12-08: Intro call (Ethan, Priya, infra lead). Discussed scale and latency goals.
- 2025-12-15: Requirements deep-dive (fireflies ff_20251215_7b9c2a). Sent initial capacity map.
- 2026-01-14: POC kickoff. Provided sample dataset (10M vectors) and config for batching + caching.
- 2026-01-28: Baseline run 10M -> qps stable 300, p95 150ms for rerank at top-20. Ticket filed INFR-7421 for tuning.
- 2026-02-05: Ran optimized batching (grouped embed requests) — p95 improved to 110ms, cost ~18% lower. See thread:1803b4e2-poc-results.
- 2026-02-10: Security questionnaire submitted; waiting SOC2/ISO artifacts; raised SEC-215 for KMS handshake details.

Quote from Infra lead on call: "We need predictable unit economics — if we can't hit <$0.001 per query at scale, we can't justify a platform switch."

Redwood fit / asks for Redwood team:
- Dedicated pools with reserved GPU capacity (predictable throughput) + private control plane for audit logging.
- Very specific autoscaling policy: allow planned bulk-indexing bursts (up to 3x baseline) without losing cached state.
- Optimizer suggestions: batching thresholds, cache TTL defaults per workload, model/quantization recommendations per route.
- Routing: prefer region affinity (US-EAST) and policy-based fallbacks to quantized variants to keep SLOs.

Open questions / risks:
- Can Redwood Optimize provide cost projections at 200M+ index scale for both embedding storage and rerank CPU/GPU cost?
- How does prefix caching interact with on-prem network egress during hybrid queries?
- Security: need formal KMS/HSM integration doc and SOC2/ISO artifacts (deadline for procurement: 2026-03-20).

Next steps (short):
- Run 100M-scale simulated ingest in Redwood Dedicated sandbox (Priya to coordinate infra lab) — target week of 2026-03-01.
- AE to send SOW + bulk-index pricing sheet by 2026-02-20.
- Security to receive SOC2/ISO artifacts and KMS integration guide (Ethan -> Security team).

Misc CRM notes (shorthand):
- CSM early involvement requested because onboarding will be heavy.
- Wants tagging per-route for cost attribution to desks.
- Wants examples of rerank-distillation tradeoffs (latency vs precision).
